key_insight: For day-ahead solar PV forecasting, input feature selection mattered more than the choice among strong algorithms, with the best models achieving 11.6% nRMSE.
engineering_relevance: Reproducible evaluation, reference forecasts and calibrated prediction intervals can make PV forecasts more trustworthy for operational deployment.
method: Combine automated model search with explainable AI.
Evaluate day-ahead forecasts against smart persistence and examine validation-split effects.
Calibrate prediction intervals with conformal methods and test SHAP attribution stability.
evidence_signal: On an open dataset from a 16.32 kWp Porto plant using 4 km weather forecasts, a full test year showed roughly half the error of smart persistence and 81.7% coverage for calibrated nominal 80% intervals, versus 64.5% before calibration.
watch_item: SHAP rankings changed when correlated inputs were removed, so attributions describe the fitted model rather than the plant's physical behavior.
paper_title: Explainable AI for Solar PV Power Forecasting: From Model Selection to Trustworthy, Reproducible Deployment
